description: Offensive security. Chains individual security weaknesses into actionable attack paths so a defender can test them. Founded by one of Mandiant's founders.
Tools and an API for developers who put AI agents inside messaging apps, including iMessage and WhatsApp. Tech Funding News describes the company as Vercel-backed.

AI agents for medical practices that handle patient calls, appointment scheduling, exam-preparation questions and administrative requests. Norrsken VC led, with Heal Capital, Speedinvest and Firstminute Capital. Total raised $25M.

AI platform that runs order-to-cash for finance teams: collections, cash application, payments, disputes and deductions. Insight Partners led; Andreessen Horowitz and M12 took part. Total raised $93M.
Builds agents ("Engines") that take ongoing responsibility for business outcomes over weeks or months. Benchmark and Index Ventures led. No revenue or customer outcomes disclosed.

General-purpose AI agent that completes multistep tasks on a user's computer. Recorded at a $500M floor because the report says "more than $500 million". Boyu Capital led, with Tencent. The $4B valuation is Bloomberg's September report, not confirmed by the company.
Gives each employee an AI assistant ("Townies") that can now ask other assistants questions and hand off tasks across a team. Forerunner Ventures and Menlo Ventures co-led.
Runtime visibility and policy enforcement for AI agents, with an open-source telemetry layer for agent activity. Tower Research Ventures led.

Isolated cloud sandboxes where AI agents run code and operate software. FirstMark Growth led. Total raised $91M. The company says revenue run rate is up about 25x since January, from an undisclosed base.

Marketing, sales and customer-service agents that run inside WhatsApp, LINE, Instagram and other chat channels for retail brands. Openspace Capital led, with Darwin Ventures and Acorn Pacific Ventures.
AI agents that take paperwork off investment teams at hospitals, pension funds and foundations. Lobby Capital led, with Madrona. Total raised about $14.5M.

Agentic commerce platform that connects merchants to AI shopping channels; launched Ask Agent. Squarepoint Capital led, with J.P. Morgan Payments, Mastercard and Samsung NEXT. Borderline on scope, included on the same basis as Omnichat.

Reviews an AI agent's proposed actions against its whole session before they run, then allows, asks for approval, redirects or blocks. Battery Ventures led the Series A. Also discloses a previously unannounced $13M seed (YL Ventures and Striker); $50M in total.

AI agents for sales teams that research accounts, find prospects, prepare outreach and manage deals, positioned against traditional CRM. General Catalyst and March Capital co-led. Previously raised $50M (seed and Series A, November 2024).
